text: FTMO owns OANDA Global Corporation: it completed the acquisition of OANDA from CVC Asia Fund IV on 1 December 2025, after sign-off from five regulators, and plans to keep the OANDA group as a standalone business.
short: FTMO bought OANDA from CVC and closed the deal on 1 December 2025.

source.name: OANDA press release – 'FTMO Building Global Trading Powerhouse – Completes Acquisition of OANDA from CVC'
source.quote: FTMO, the global leader in modern prop trading, has completed the acquisition of OANDA Global Corporation
